info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Servicing By Param1-spec
info.description: The Servicing Issue Management API enables the updating of servicing issues identified by specific parameters for streamlined customer support. This endpoint allows businesses to modify existing service issues, enhancing responsiveness to client needs and operational efficiency. Typical consumers include maintenance teams, support staff, and third-party service integrators who require up-to-date systems for managing service requests. Leveraging this API improves the overall service quality and ensures clients receive timely resolutions.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific servicing issue identified by its unique reference ID. Providing the necessary fields will enable you to modify the pertinent information.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the servicing issue with the specified ID. The content must be in JSON format and adhere to the defined schema for the PATCH operation.
